name: Legacy of Hestia
source:
Your grandfather has always told you tales about adventurers and what it means to become one. You always found them to be exciting, so upon turning 18 years old, you finally have the chance to join a Familia and become one yourself.
However, becoming an adventurer is not as easy as you had hoped... Only after many days of hardship, you are finally approached by a Goddess who invites you to join her newly created Familia. What choices will you make and how will they affect your future?
